propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof that Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid, even when credentials are valid and managed via git credential helper.
AGENTS.md must document that authenticated Gerrit /a/ REST polling must use git credential fill when checkout uses a Git credential helper, not curl --netrc.
curl --netrc is only valid for Gerrit REST authentication when .netrc was explicitly configured; git credential helper-sourced credentials should not be checked via curl --netrc.
The documented curl pattern for Gerrit REST calls must never echo or log the password and must preserve existing git push and gate guidance.
test_codex_agent_guidance.py must assert correct use of git credential fill, curl --netrc conditions, false-401 explanation, and password non-logging requirement.
